title: Townsend Brown and the Nassau Group

tellings.quote: Towns and Brown also spent a ton of time in Nassau. In fact, his biographer Paul Shatskin even coined a term for a secret group that used to meet there. It was called the Nassau Group

plain: Thomas Townsend Brown, an inventor whose biography is titled The Man Who Mastered Gravity, spent a lot of time in Nassau in the Bahamas, where a secret group used to meet. Jesse Michels tells it himself, saying Brown's biographer, Paul Schatzkin, coined a name for that group: the Nassau Group. Michels raises it because it would point to a hidden circle meeting around Brown's work.
